title: Who’s coming
description: Public list of registered participants of Battle for Middle-earth 2026. See who’s heading to Middle-earth and how the sides and armies are filling up.
subtitle: See who’s heading to Middle-earth and how the sides and armies are filling up.
alert_pre: The public list of registered participants is in preparation. It will be connected to the
alert_post: registration system and updated continuously. In the meantime you’ll find the structure of armies and sides and links to the overview of roles here.
how_l2: If a participant fills in a public group / unit, we will show that too.
how_l3: We do not publish age, contacts, payment, documents or guardian information.
how_l4: For younger participants we display only a nickname, or include them only in summary counts.
how_l5: Filtering will be by sides, armies and other roles.
how_l6: Search will work by name, nickname, group or army.
factions_intro: Until the integration with the registration system is ready, here is a tentative structure of how participants will be divided:
privacy_p1_pre: The public list serves as an orientation for participants and community communication. We work with minimum data — only what the participant has marked as public in registration. Details in
privacy_p2: If you don’t want to appear on the list, set your profile as non-public in registration, or write us.
cta_body: Middle-earth is waiting. Registration runs via Registračka.cz and the registration fee must be paid within 10 days of registering.
